reviews.author: Mick T
reviews.text: I really wanted to love Kam's Roast Goose, but the experience was a massive letdown. While the food is "decent," it certainly doesn't justify the logistical nightmare and the lack of respect for sit-down diners.

reviews.author: Nitin Subhash
reviews.text: The Central–Mid-Levels Escalator is a unique Hong Kong experience, an 800-meter covered ride through bustling streets, linking Central to the Mid-Levels. It's both practical and fun, offering glimpses of cafés, shops, and local life along the way. A quirky urban adventure worth trying.
